gap_notes: CORE cannot be scored: Ptolemy/Lilly cold/dry/malefic, Houlding boundary/constraint, Greene psychic-process, and Hand resistance/structure are different categories, not an intersection. Do not teach Saturn=structure as CORE, and do not write Ptolemy as confirming structure-setting.

Valens I.1 is a topical/significator catalog (sect, colour, taste, body parts), not Ptolemy/Lilly elemental qualities. Do not backfill heat/cold/dry/moist from Valens, and do not average catalogs into function.
Valens I.1: injuries from cold AND moisture (dropsy and the like). That collides with Ptolemy/Lilly secondary dryness. Do not collapse Saturn to dry.
Valens: malefics in sect can bestow good. Do not add Valens to the compared 'traditionally malefic' lemma.

Houlding Saturn article attests personal boundary and maturation through constraint as living-traditional lemmas. That is not Ptolemy confirming identity-structure, and not Greene individuation. Do not average them into function.
Houlding's astronomy-to-signification causal story is her explanatory model, not a TodayFlow fact. Slow tempo is compared as a quality only.
Houlding quotes Greene's membrane lemma; that line is not attested in our opened Introduction and is not ingested as a Greene claim.
Mundane Signification professions/illnesses/places were opened and not copied as a catalog.
External Saturn pilot (T1-T4 scale, premature canonical_fields, T2 Rudhyar/Arroyo/Sasportas/Hand/Firmicus/Dorotheus) is research input, not IL schema. Not ingested.
Object-level themes mix compared and school_specific lemmas. Per-lemma evidence_tier stays in this ledger; knowledge-object schema is not expanded for that.
Layer 1 requires positive_expression; it remains Lilly well-dignified manners. Greene fulfilment/freedom and Houlding boundary are not copied into object slots. function stays classical.

Greene Weiser Classics 2021 Introduction opened via Red Wheel/Weiser Calaméo preview (ISBN 978-1-57863-735-5; Intro p.1-8). Same preview includes watery signs/houses ch.1; not ingested (planet-in-house is Layer 5).

Hand Horoscope Symbols Ch.4 Saturn ingested as professional school_specific. Resistance ≠ punishment. Consensus reality ≠ absolute truth. Consequences ≠ metaphysical karma. Responsibility ≠ guilt. Visibility-boundary is symbolic, not an astronomy fact. Do not merge with Houlding or Greene. runtime_semantic_candidate is not a schema field.
